headword: {正真正銘|しょうしんしょうめい}
reading: しょうしんしょうめい

definitions.gloss: genuine; authentic; undeniable; the real deal
definitions.explanation: Emphasizes that something is absolutely genuine and beyond any doubt. A four-character compound ({四字熟語|よじじゅくご}) used for strong emphasis.

examples.japanese: これは{正真正銘|しょうしんしょうめい}の{本物|ほんもの}だ。
{彼|かれ}は{正真正銘|しょうしんしょうめい}のプロだ。
{正真正銘|しょうしんしょうめい}の{天才|てんさい}と{呼|よ}ばれた{音楽家|おんがくか}は、{幼|おさな}いころから{才能|さいのう}を{見|み}せていた。
examples.english: The musician called a true genius had shown talent since childhood.

notes:
A {四字熟語|よじじゅくご} (four-character idiom) meaning "absolutely genuine" or "the real deal." Literally, both {正真|しょうしん} and {正銘|しょうめい} mean "genuine" — doubling for emphatic force.

GRAMMAR:
Functions as a の-adjective: {正真正銘|しょうしんしょうめい}の + noun.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {正真正銘|しょうしんしょうめい}の{本物|ほんもの}: the genuine article
- {正真正銘|しょうしんしょうめい}のプロ: a true professional
- {正真正銘|しょうしんしょうめい}の{天才|てんさい}: an undeniable genius

STRENGTH COMPARISON:
- {本当|ほんとう}の: real, true (neutral)
- {本物|ほんもの}の: genuine (moderate emphasis)
- {正真正銘|しょうしんしょうめい}の: absolutely genuine (strongest emphasis)

REGISTER:
Slightly dramatic or literary. Often used in speech for rhetorical effect.
